summary: Describes the Handover Keying (HOKEY) problem of re-authenticating quickly when a mobile device moves between access points. The existing EAP key framework forces a full EAP exchange again, which causes long delays. It states design goals for reusing derived keying material in handovers. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Showing your ticket again each time you walk into a new room is slow. This paper asks how to prove who you are once and move around quickly.
